title: The Search request, its hits frame, and the server's answer
spec: Request tag 9 Search { query (1 to MAX_QUERY bytes) }, announced by FEATURE_SEARCH (2), answered Ok { cursor: n } then one hits frame (tag 132: id, u16 n up to MAX_HITS, each room, u64 cursor, author up to MAX_AUTHOR, snippet up to MAX_SNIPPET), with the same limit checks both ways and Truncated/TrailingBytes/BadKind as the room-list frame. DurableServer::found gives each hit's author and the start of its current plain text (an edit's new text; cut at a character boundary), newest first, only from the asker's rooms; a connection over a server without a journal answers Ok { cursor: 0 } and an empty hits frame. The network server advertises FEATURE_SEARCH.
